ops.title: capt-hook: test_transcripts_registration is order-fragile (two distinct flakes)
ops.description: 12.8.0's tests/test_transcripts_registration.py flakes two ways: (1) TestRegisteredPaths::test_resolves_thread_id_against_codex_root fails in CI full-suite runs (ValueError: not enough values to unpack — resolver returns () despite monkeypatched codex.SESSIONS_ROOT; passes solo locally); (2) TestMcpTool::test_mcp_tool_hits_the_same_slot fails when the file runs together locally while the codex-root test passes. State pollution between tests suspected (shared session-state roots / idempotence keys). Evidence: CI run 29822905465 on 244849d1 (1 failed / 3979 passed) and parent 2d43d51f red with the same class.

ops.text: full file green solo AND in full-suite CI, 3 consecutive runs
